identity.name: INOXWIND
identity.industry: Wind Turbine OEM & Renewable Energy Transition (manufacturing + O&M)

summary.oneLiner: Inox Wind is deliberately pivoting from working-capital-heavy turnkey EPC (now ~25% of book) to ~75–80% equipment supply, leaning on captive group demand (Inox Clean's 14 GW-by-FY29 build-out) and a fast-scaling O&M arm (Inox Green) to convert a stalled, value-destroyed FY26 into a 75%-growth FY27 — a story heavily dependent on group-internal orders materialising.

one-line thesis: Inox Wind is deliberately pivoting from working-capital-heavy turnkey EPC (now ~25% of book) to ~75–80% equipment supply, leaning on captive group demand (Inox Clean's 14 GW-by-FY29 build-out) and a fast-scaling O&M arm (Inox Green) to convert a stalled, value-destroyed FY26 into a 75%-growth FY27 — a story heavily dependent on group-internal orders materialising.
financial scorecard: One-offs / accounting flags: ~INR 40 cr of Inox Green "other income" is acquisition-debt-related (PAT impact ~INR 25–26 cr); ex-this, Inox Green annual EBITDA margin ~45% vs reported ~50%. IRSL demerger removed ~INR 1,000 cr gross block and ~INR 50–55 cr annual depreciation from Inox Green.
guidance (next-period verification): FY27 consol revenue: ~75% growth over FY26 (i.e. ~INR 7,500 cr on INR 4,500 cr base); EBITDA margin ~20%+ (mgmt stated "20% to 20%", reads as floor ~20%).
70–75% growth across revenue/EBITDA/PAT; described as set on a conservative basis ("unless world war / COVID lockdown").

Inox Green FY27 EBITDA: north of INR 600 cr (vs FY26 EBITDA ~INR 210 cr on ~INR 426 cr turnover); ~all converts to operating cash profit (tax shield up to INR 700 cr losses, no depreciation/finance cost post-demerger).
~INR 400 cr of slipped FY26 revenue to be recovered in Q1/Q2 FY27 (next-quarter watch).
order book & pipeline: Consolidated order book 3.1 GW, well diversified; named customers: Aditya Birla, Gentari/Amplus, Jakson Green, First Energy, Leap Green.
~500 MW (~16%) currently from group co Inox Clean; going forward ~1/3 of annual execution to be Inox Clean (3 GW+ p.a. capacity, of which 20–30% wind).
Multiple external customer negotiations "nearing closure." >24 months visibility; mgmt claims "sold out for next ~2.5 years."
segment / subsidiary detail: Inox Green (O&M): 13+ GWp portfolio, targeting largest O&M in India this year, top globally by 2030. Acquired ~6.5 GW operational wind O&M of 2 erstwhile OEMs (4.5 GW + 2 GW); consolidation pending final NCLT/EOI clearances (entity 1 order in ~2 weeks; entity 2 in 60–90 days). Both accrue from 1-Apr-26. Adds ~5 GW over the year + 1.5 GW organic → 11 GW+. Two acquisitions carry ~50% EBITDA margin.
IRSL (evacuation infra): demerger from Inox Green into IRSL approved by NCLT Ahmedabad; auto-listing post approvals (1–2 months). Houses larger EPC arm + crane fleet; moving to high-value services.
Inox Clean (group, unlisted): "10^3 GW" play — 10 GW IPP + 10 GW solar cell + 10 GW solar module over ~15 months; raised ~$750m at ~couple-billion-$ valuation; fastest to 2 GW installed.
growth verticals / optionality: Power electronics foray ("in a big way"): transformers (large/small/solar), inverters, ECS systems — large grid/RE demand; details over coming months.
New 4.4 MW turbine launch on-track within CY26 (deeper penetration + margin uplift).
Inox Green WTG life-extension / overhaul packages; "Agent AI" for low-value O&M jobs; Vayuveer/Inox Learning Academy producing ~600 skilled staff/yr (hiring Agniveers).
IRSL listing as a value-unlock catalyst.
margins & cost dynamics: IWL guided ~20%+ EBITDA margin; mgmt insists equipment-supply shift keeps margins "more or less similar or higher," not a dramatic kicker — turnkey can fetch better price but margins erode via land/ROW/payment-delay risk; equipment supply is firm, LC-based, upfront cash, steel pass-through.
Rising O&M mix (50% margin business) biases blended margin higher.
Backward integration (cranes ~50% in-house → fully in-house this year; transformers ramping) supports margins/liquidity.
capex / expansion: Backward/forward integration into cranes, transformers, power electronics (capex implied, quantum not disclosed).
New 4.4 MW turbine commercialisation within CY26.
Group-level (Inox Clean) is the heavy-capex vehicle for solar cell/module + IPP.
capital allocation: Inox Green to deploy ~INR 600 cr FY27 cash profit: first integrate 2 acquisitions, then selective GW-scale acquisitions ("≤10–20% of FCF"); limited targets left (sector consolidated: of 5 players, 2 allied, 3 bankrupt, 2 of those acquired). Dividend policy deferred until consolidation done; buyback "not at this point."
IWEL merged into IWL (promoters cited minority-shareholder protection over their own control preference).
risks & watch-items: Guidance credibility / overcommit history — sharply challenged by investors (megawatt→revenue metric switch, FY26 revenue miss, YoY decline vs peers doing ~40% growth). Mgmt cites force-majeure (geopolitics/shipping/ECS delay, PSU payment delay).
Working capital — Q3 target of ~200 net WC days; not clearly confirmed at Q4. Whole thesis hinges on equipment-supply pivot fixing this.
Group-related-party dependence — ~1/3 future execution from captive Inox Clean; large share of Inox Green "income" is acquisition/treasury-related, not core operating.
Execution risk — ROW/grid-connectivity delays; majority EPC closure pushed to H1 FY27.
Receivables — PSU contract delays (mgmt says resolved).
Acquisition closing risk — both Inox Green acquisitions still awaiting NCLT/EOI clearances.
management quality / tone: Defensive-but-assertive. Devansh Jain pushed back hard ("I beg to disagree") on value-destruction and overcommit criticism, anchoring on 4-year track record and ~$10bn renewable-arm valuation; dismissive of "short-term aberrations in market cap." Candid admission of "some failures." Tone is conviction-heavy and group-narrative-driven; investors visibly skeptical on delivery vs promises.
non-obvious takeaways: The real engine is Inox Clean (unlisted) captive demand — minority IWL/IGESL shareholders are effectively riding a related-party order pipeline they cannot directly own.

Reported Inox Green profitability is materially inflated by acquisition-debt "other income" (~INR 40 cr/qtr); core O&M margin ~45% vs headline ~50%, and quarterly revenue is lumpy (Q3 ~INR 78 cr → Q4 ~INR 69 cr).
Company has stopped giving MW execution numbers entirely — reduces accountability/comparability vs peers.
IRSL auto-listing is a near-term (1–2 month) value-unlock event to watch.
"Only Indian wind player to survive with zero haircut" — sector has effectively consolidated to Inox + one rival.
qoq change log: This quarter (Q4 FY26):
FY26 revenue landed ~INR 4,500–4,600 cr vs ~INR 5,000 cr guide (geopolitics/ECS/PSU delays); Q4 revenue flat YoY at INR 1,306 cr.
Turnkey→equipment-supply mix now ~25%/75% (was 100% turnkey 24 months ago; 50:50 cited earlier in call → targeting 75–80% equipment).
IRSL demerger approved by NCLT Ahmedabad; ~INR 1,000 cr gross block & ~INR 50–55 cr depreciation removed from Inox Green.
Inox Green portfolio to 13+ GWp; two O&M acquisitions (4.5 + 2 GW) announced, consolidation pending.
Stopped MW guidance; revenue-only basis reaffirmed.
Next-quarter (Q1/Q2 FY27) watch items:
Recovery of ~INR 400 cr slipped FY26 revenue.
Closure/consolidation of the two Inox Green acquisitions (entity 1 ~2 wks, entity 2 60–90 days).
IRSL listing completion (1–2 months) — value-unlock catalyst.
Net working-capital days trend (target ~200) — proof of the pivot.
4.4 MW turbine approvals/commercial launch within CY26.
New external order closures converting "nearing closure" pipeline.

themes.title: Renewable IPP / FDRE firm-power & storage
themes.need: DISCOMs mandating firm/round-the-clock RE make BESS + pumped-hydro the bid differentiator, and in Q1FY27 storage demand ran ahead of supply. ADANIGREEN has 3.5 GWh of BESS installed (+1.9 GWh at Khavda this quarter), targets 10+ GWh this fiscal and 50 GWh by FY30 on a thumb-rule INR 25-30 lakh of EBITDA per MWh against ~INR 1.5cr/MWh of capex, and has contracted essentially all merchant/C&I capacity to sibling AESL on 25-year (solar/wind) and 15-year (battery) fixed-price PPAs targeting ~15-16% IRR - a pivot from merchant builder to fixed-return contracted IPP, with evacuation (not panels) named as the binding constraint. JSWENERGY added 873 MW in Q1 and ~1.1 GW since April - 36% of its 3 GW FY27 target already banked, Tidong Hydro commissioned four months early - and raised INR 10,150cr, taking net leverage 5.2x to 4.95x. On the equipment side SERVOTECH said its BESS pack capacity is fully booked ('we are not able to meet the demand') and committed to 2x capacity in 6 months, 3x by 21-Mar-2027 and 10x within 2 years. ACMESOLAR/KPIGREEN/SUZLON/INOXWIND attach storage to solar/wind; NTPC/NHPC/SJVN/TATAPOWER drive pumped-hydro and utility-scale storage.
themes.driver: BESS capacity commissioning against demand two independent managements (ADANIGREEN, SERVOTECH) say already exceeds supply; FDRE/peak-power tender awards; merchant DAM prices (JSWENERGY: INR 4.40 -> INR 5.10/unit, +16%) on +8.5% Q1 power demand.
